title: Even modest homes in Delhi cost over ₹2 crore: Why Delhi High Court said pecuniary limits need reconsideration
description: Since even modest residential properties now cost more than ₹2 crore, people are compelled to file proceedings before the High Court instead of civil or district judges, the Delhi High Court recently said.A Division Bench of Justices Anil Kshetarpal and Tejas Karia made the observation while highlighting the importance of reconsidering the pecuniary limits of courts in the national capitalPecuniary limits refer to the maximum or minimum monetary value of a case that a court can hear and decide.
